gloss: soul, living being, life, self, person, desire, appetite, emotion, and passion
definition: נֶ֫פֶשׁ 756 noun feminine Gen 49:6 (so even Gen 2:19 ; Num 31:28 ; 1Kgs 19:2 see Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 42 SS ) soul, living being, life, self, person, desire, appetite, emotion, and passion ( Eccl 3:18 ; Eccl 4:1 (twice in verse); Eccl 4:2 (twice in verse); Eccl 13:12 ; Eccl 14:11 ); — ׳ נ Gen 1:20 +; נָ֑פֶשׁ Gen 37:21 +; suffix נַפְשִׁי Gen 12:13 +; plural נְפָשׁוֺת Ezek 13:18 + 13 t.; נְפָשֹׁת Exod 12:4 ; Lev 27:2 construct נַפְשׁוֺת Gen 36:6 + 4 t.; נַפְשֹׁת Lev 21:11 נְפָשִׁים Ezek 13:20 (but read חָפְשִׁים , see Co Berthol Toy); suffix נַפְשׁוֺתָם 2Sam 23:17 +; נַפְשֹׁתָם Num 17:3 +: — 1. = that which breathes, the breathing substance or being = ψυχή , anima, the soul, the inner being of man: \ \ a. distinguished from ׃בָּשָׂר מִנֶּפֶשׁ וְעַד בָּשָׂר Isa 10:18 הַנֶּפֶשׁ עִם הַבָּשָׂר Deut 12:23 from שְׁאֵר Prov 11:17 from בֶּטֶן body Ps 31:10 . \ \ b. both the inner נפשׁ and the outer בשׂר are conceived as resting on a common substratum: אַךְ בְּשָׂרוֺ עָלָיו יִכְאָ֑ב וְנַפְשׁוֺ עָלָיו תֶּאֱבָֽל׃ Job 14:22 only his flesh upon him is in pain, and his soul upon him mourneth ; compare Ps 42:5 ; Ps 42:7 ; Ps 131:2 ; Job 30:16 ; Lam 3:20 [see עַל 1 d ], all poetical (compare 6 c ). \ \ c. ׳ נ departs at death and returns with life: וַיְתִי בְּצֵאת נַפְשָׁהּ כִּי מֵתָה Gen 35:18 ( E ) and it came to pass when her soul was going forth ( for she died ); נָָֽפְחָה נַפְשָׁהּ Jer 15:9 she breathed out her soul , compare 1Kgs 17:21 ; 1Kgs 17:22 ; Job 11:20 ; Job 31:39 . \ \ d. often desired that the נפשׁ may be delivered: from Sh®°ôl Ps 16:10 ; Ps 30:4 ; Ps 49:16 ; Ps 86:13 ; Ps 89:49 ; Prov 23:14 from שַׁחַת , the pit of Sh®°ôl , Isa 38:17 ; Job 33:18 ; Job 33:22 ; Job 33:28 ; Job 33:30 . 2. The נפשׁ becomes a living being: by God's breathing נשׁמת חיים into the nostrils of its בשׂר ; of man Gen 2:7 ( J ); by implication of animals also Gen 2:19 ( J ); so Ps 104:29 ; Ps 104:30 compare Ps 66:9 man is נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה , a living, breathing being Gen 2:7 ( J ); elsewhere נפשׁ חיּה always of animals Gen 1:20 ; Gen 1:24 ; Gen 1:30 ; Gen 9:12 ; Gen 9:15 ; Gen 9:16 (all P ), Ezek 47:9 so נפשׁ החיּה Gen 1:21 ; Gen 9:10 (both P ), Lev 11:10 ; Lev 11:46 ( H ); נפשׁ השׁרצת Lev 11:46 ( H ); נפשׁ כל חי Job 12:10 . נפשׁ is frequently used with the verb ׃חיה וחיתה נפשׁ Gen 12:13 ; Gen 19:20 (both J ), 1Kgs 20:32 ( E ), Ps 119:175 ; Jer 38:17 ; Jer 38:20 חֵי נַפְשְׁךָ 1Sam 1:26 ; 1Sam 17:55 ; 1Sam 20:3 ; 1Sam 25:26 ; 2Sam 11:11 ; 2Sam 14:9 ; 2Kgs 2:2 ; 2Kgs 2:4 ; 2Kgs 2:6 ; 2Kgs 4:30 (all J E ); compare ׳ יְחַיֶּה נ 1Kgs 20:31 ( E ), Ezek 18:27 ; Ps 22:30 also Gen 19:19 ; Isa 55:3 ; Prov 3:22 . 3. The נפשׁ (without חיה noun or verb) is specified: \ \ a. a living being whose life resides in the blood [so in Arabic We Skizzen iii. 217 G. Jacob Arab. Dicht. iv. 9 f. ] (hence sacrificial use of blood, and its prohib. in other uses; first in D ), Deut 12:23 ; Deut 12:24 only be sure that thou eat not the blood, for the blood is the living being ( הַדָּם הוּא הַנֶּפֶשׁ ); and thou shalt not eat the living being with the flesh ( הַנֶּפֶשׁ עִם הַבָּשָׂר ); thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water ; this is enlarged in H , Lev 17:10 ; Lev 17:11 ; Lev 17:12 ; Lev 17:14 and in P Gen 9:4 ; Gen 9:5 , compare Jer 2:34 . \ \ b. a serious attack upon the life is an attack upon this inner living being 2Sam 1:9 ; Jer 4:10 ; Jonah 2:6 ; Ps 69:2 ; Ps 124:4 ; Ps 124:5 ; Job 27:3 . \ \ c. נפשׁ is used for life itself 171 t., of animals Prov 12:10 , and of man Gen 44:30 ( J ); נפשׁ תחת נפשׁ life for life Exod 21:23 ( E ), Lev 24:18 ( H ), 1Kgs 20:39 ; 1Kgs 20:42 ; 2Kgs 10:24 נפשׁנו תחתיכם Josh 2:14 ( J ); נפשׁ בנפשׁ Deut 19:21 בנפשׁ for the life of 2Sam 14:7 ; Jonah 1:14 שׂם נפשׁ בכף put life in one's own hand Judg 12:3 ; 1Sam 19:5 ; 1Sam 28:21 ; Job 13:14 חרף נפשׁו למות Judg 5:18 risked his life to die ; בנפשׁ at the risk of life Num 17:3 ( P ), 2Sam 23:17 = 1Chr 11:19 (twice in verse), 1Kgs 2:23 ; Prov 7:23 ; Lam 5:9 בקּשׁ נפשׁ Exod 4:19 ( J ), 1Sam 20:21 ; 1Sam 22:23 (twice in verse); 1Sam 23:15 ; 1Sam 25:29 ; 2Sam 4:8 ; 2Sam 16:11 ; 1Kgs 19:10 ; 1Kgs 19:14 ; Jer 4:30 ; Jer 11:21 ; Jer 19:7 ; Jer 19:9 ; Jer 21:7 ; Jer 22:25 ; Jer 34:20 ; Jer 34:21 ; Jer 38:16 ; Jer 44:30 (twice in verse); Jer 46:26 ; Jer 49:37 ; Ps 35:4 ; Ps 38:13 ; Ps 40:15 ; Ps 54:5 ; Ps 63:10 ; Ps 70:3 ; Ps 86:14 ; Prov 29:10 ׳ שׁאל נ 1Kgs 3:11 = 2Chr 1:11 ; 1Kgs 19:4 = Jonah 4:8 הִכָּה נפשׁ smite mortally Gen 37:21 ( J ), Deut 19:6 ; Deut 19:11 ; Jer 40:14 ; Jer 40:15 ׳ לקח נ 1Kgs 19:4 ; Jonah 4:3 ; Ps 31:14 ; Prov 1:19 הִצִּיל נֶפֶשׁ מִמָּוֶת deliver life from death Josh 2:13 ; Ps 33:19 ; Ps 56:14 מלּט נפשׁ 1Sam 19:11 ; 2Sam 19:6 (4 t. in verse); 1Kgs 1:12 (twice in verse); Jer 48:6 ; Jer 51:6 ; Jer 51:45 ; Ezek 33:5 ; Amos 2:14 ; Amos 2:15 ; Ps 89:49 ; Ps 116:4 פדה ׳ נ 2Sam 4:9 ; 1Kgs 1:29 ; Ps 34:23 ; Ps 49:16 ; Ps 55:19 ; Ps 71:23 ׳ שׁמר נ Ps 25:20 ; Ps 97:10 ; Job 2:6 ; Prov 13:3 ; Prov 16:17 ; Prov 19:16 ; Prov 22:5 . 4. The נפשׁ as the essential of man stands for the man himself: \ \ a. paraphrase for personal pronoun especially in poetry and ornate discourse, 70 t.; (1) נַפְשִׁי = me: אל תבא נפשׁי Gen 49:6 let me not enter (poem in J ); מות ישׁרים ׳ תָּמֹת נ Num 23:10 let me die , etc. (poem); תָּמוֺת נַפְשְׁי Judg 16:30 ( J ); אמרה נפשׁי Lam 3:24 I say . (2) נַפְשְׁךָ = thee: לְאֻמִּים תַּחַת נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ Isa 43:4 peoples instead of thee ; אָֽמְרוּ לְנַפְשֵׁךְ Isa 51:23 . (3) נַפְשׁוֺ = he: נפשׁו בטוב תלין Psalms he will not dwell in good circumstances . (4) נַפְשֵׁנוּ = we: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֺר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֺקְשִׁים Ps 124:7 . (5) נַפְשָׁם = they, them: נַפְשָׁם בַּשְּׁבִי הָלָ֑כָה Isa 46:2 they are gone into captivity ; אוי לנפשׁם Isa 3:9 . \ \ b. = reflexive, self , 53 t.: אסר על נפשׁ bind oneself Num 30:3 ; Num 30:5 (twice in verse); Num 30:6 ; Num 30:7 ; Num 30:8 ; Num 30:9 ; Num 30:10 ; Num 30:11 ; Num 30:12 ׳ לְעַנֹּת נ Num 30:14 to afflict oneself . (1) נַפְשִׁי = myself: לא אדע נפשׁי Job 9:21 I know not myself . (2) נַפְשְׁךָ = thyself: ׳ שׁמר נ Deut 4:9 keep thyself . (3) נַפְשׁוֺ = himself: ׳ אהב כנ 1Sam 18:1 ; 1Sam 18:3 ; 1Sam 20:17 loved as himself . (4) נַפְשָׁהּ = herself: ׳ צדּקה נ Jer 3:11 justified herself . (5) נַפְשָׁם = themselves: ׳ הציל נ deliver themselves Isa 47:14 ; Ezek 14:14 ; Ezek 14:20 . (6) נַפְשְׁכֶם , נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם = yourselves: ׳ אַלתַּֿשִּׁאוּ נ Jer 37:9 deceive not yourselves , also Jer 42:20 ; Jer 44:7 ׳ ענּה נ Lev 16:29 ; Lev 16:31 ; Lev 23:27 ; Lev 23:32 ; Num 29:7 ( P ); ׳ נשׁמרתם לנ Deut 4:15 ; Josh 23:11 ( D ). (7) נַפְשׁוֺתֵינוּ = ourselves: ׳ על נ Jer 26:19 against ourselves . \ \ c. = person of man, individual, 144 t., first in D 2 ; especially in H , P , and kindred writers: (1) with אָדָם : אדם ׳ נ Lev 24:17 opposed to בהמה ׳ נ Lev 24:18 (both H ), and so אדם ׳ נ human persons Num 31:35 ; Num 31:40 ; Num 31:46 ( P ) 1Chr 5:21 ; Ezek 27:13 . Elsewhere without אדם : ברכה ׳ נ Prov 11:25 one who blesses ; רְמִיָּה ׳ נ Prov 19:15 idle person ; ׳ תחת נ ׳ נ person in place of person , Job 16:4 כפּר ׳ על נ Exod 30:15 ; Exod 30:16 ; Num 15:28 ; Num 31:50 (all P ) Lev 17:11 ( H ). (2) נפשׁ = person, any one: Deut 24:7 ; Deut 27:25 ; Prov 28:17 ; Ezek 18:4 (3 t. in verse); Ezek 33:6 elsewhere only H P : Lev 2:1 ; Lev 4:2 ; Lev 4:27 ; Lev 5:1 ; Lev 5:2 ; Lev 5:4 ; Lev 5:15 ; Lev 5:17 ; Lev 5:21 ; Lev 7:18 ; Lev 7:20 ; Lev 7:21 ; Lev 7:25 ; Lev 7:27 ; Lev 23:29 ; Lev 23:30 (twice in verse); Num 5:6 ; Num 15:27 ; Num 15:30 ; Num 19:22 ; Num 31:19 ; Num 31:28 ; Num 35:11 ; Num 35:15 ; Num 35:30 (twice in verse); Josh 20:3 ; Josh 20:9 (all P ), Lev 17:10 ; Lev 17:12 ; Lev 17:15 ; Lev 20:6 (twice in verse); Lev 22:6 ; Lev 22:11 (all H ); ׳ נכרתה הנ הַהִוא מן that person shall be cut off from: only in Gen 17:14 ; Exod 12:15 ; Exod 12:19 ; Exod 31:14 ; Lev 7:20 ; Lev 7:21 ; Lev 7:27 ; Num 9:13 ; Num 15:30 ; Num 15:31 ; Num 19:13 ; Num 19:20 (all P ), Lev 19:8 ; Lev 22:3 (both H ). (3) נפשׁ collective for persons , in enumerations: Deut 10:22 ; Josh 10:28 ; Josh 10:30 ; Josh 10:32 ; Josh 10:35 ; Josh 10:37 (twice in verse); Josh 10:39 ; Josh 11:11 (all D 2 ) Jer 43:6 ; Jer 52:29 ; Jer 52:30 (twice in verse); Ezek 22:25 elsewhere only Gen 12:5 ; Gen 46:15 ; Gen 46:18 ; Gen 46:22 ; Gen 46:25 ; Gen 46:26 (twice in verse); Gen 46:27 (twice in verse); Exod 1:5 (twice in verse); Exod 12:16 ; Num 31:35 ; Num 31:40 (all P ). (4) נְפָשׁוֺת persons Gen 36:6 ; Exod 12:4 ; Exod 16:16 ; Num 19:18 (all P ), Lev 18:29 ; Lev 20:25 ; Lev 27:2 (all H ), 2Kgs 12:5 ; Prov 11:30 ; Prov 14:25 ; Ezek 13:18 (3 t. in verse); Ezek 13:19 (twice in verse); Ezek 13:20 (twice in verse); Ezek 17:17 ; Ezek 18:4 ; Ezek 22:27 ( נפשׁים Ezek 13:20 see above). (5) נפשׁ = deceased person , sometimes with מֵת , נֶפֶשׁ מֵת Num 6:6 ( P ), נַפְשֹׁת מֵת ( ᵐ5 ᵑ6 נֶפֶשׁ ) Lev 21:11 ( H ); usually without מֵת , נפשׁ (ה)אדם Num 9:6 ; Num 9:7 ; Num 19:11 ; Num 19:13 ( P ); or simply נפשׁ , Lev 19:28 ; Lev 21:1 ; Lev 22:4 (all H ) Num 5:2 ; Num 6:11 ; Num 9:10 (all P ); elsewhere only Hag 2:13 . 5. נפשׁ = seat of the appetites , in all periods (46 t.) — \ \ a. hunger: רְעֵבָה ׳ נ hungry soul Ps 107:9 ; Prov 27:7 with noun or verb of שׂבע satisfy Isa 56:11 ; Isa 58:10 ; Jer 50:19 ; Ezek 7:19 ; Ps 63:6 ; Ps 107:9 ; Prov 13:25 ; Prov 27:7 ׳ מתוק לנ Prov 16:24 sweet to the taste . \ \ b. thirst: עֲיֵפָה ׳ נ weary soul Prov 25:25 ; Jer 31:25 כארץ עיפה ׳ נ Ps 143:6 ׳ צמאה נ Ps 42:3 ; Ps 63:2 . \ \ c. appetite in general: יַקִּיפוּ עָלָיו ׳ אֹיְבַי בנ Ps 17:9 my enemies compass me about with greed ; הִרְחִיבָה שְׁאוֺל נַפְשָׁהּ וּפָֽעֲרָה פִיהָ Isa 5:14 Sh®°ôl enlarged her appetite , etc., compare Hab 2:5 ; Prov 23:2 בַּעַל נֶפֶשׁ ; Ecclesiastes uses נפשׁ only in the sense of a, b, c ; the נפשׁ craves, lacks, and is filled with good things: Eccl 2:24 ; Eccl 4:8 ; Eccl 6:2 ; Eccl 6:3 ; Eccl 6:7 ; Eccl 6:9 ; Eccl 7:28 . 6. = ׳ נ seat of emotions and passions (151 t.) — \ \ a. desire: ׳ אִוְּתָה נ soul desires Deut 12:20 ; Deut 14:26 ; 1Sam 2:16 ; 2Sam 3:21 ; 1Kgs 11:37 ; Job 23:13 ; Prov 13:4 ; Prov 21:10 ; Mic 7:1 ׳ תַּאֲוַת נ Ps 10:3 ; Isa 26:8 ׳ אַוַּת נ Deut 12:15 ; Deut 12:20 ; Deut 12:21 ; Deut 18:6 ; 1Sam 23:20 ; Jer 2:24 so also לנפשׁ according to one's desire Deut 21:14 ; Ps 78:18 ; Jer 34:16 כנפשׁ Deut 23:25 האח נפשׁנו ah, our desire Ps 35:25 בנפשׁ at one's desire Ps 105:22 ; Ezek 16:27 יָָֽצְאָה ׳ נ בְדַבְּרוֺ Song 5:6 ׳ נשׂא נ lift up the soul, desire Deut 24:15 ; 2Sam 14:14 (read אליהם , not אלהים ), Ps 24:4 ; Ps 25:1 ; Ps 86:4 ; Ps 143:8 ; Prov 19:8 ; Jer 22:27 ; Jer 44:14 ; Hos 4:8 . \ \ b. abhorrence, loathing: ׳ געלה נ soul abhorreth Lev 26:11 ; Lev 26:15 ; Lev 26:30 ; Lev 26:43 ( H ) Jer 14:19 בחלה בי ׳ וגם נ Zech 11:8 and their soul also fell a loathing against me . \ \ c. sorrow and distress: ׳ מרי נ bitter, gloomy, discontented of soul Judg 18:25 ( E ) 2Sam 17:8 ; Job 3:20 ; Prov 31:6 ׳ מר נ 1Sam 22:2 compare Job 7:11 ; Job 10:1 ; Isa 38:15 ; Ezek 27:1 ׳ עָֽגְמָה נ Job 30:35 grieved ; ׳ אגמי נ sad of soul Isa 19:10 ׳ תבכה נ my soul shall weep Jer 13:17 ירעה ׳ נ his soul trembleth Isa 15:4 ׳ צרת נ distress of soul Gen 42:21 ( E ). \ \ d. joy: תגיל ׳ נ my soul rejoiceth Ps 35:9 ; Isa 61:10 ׳ שׂמּח נ rejoice the soul Ps 86:4 also Ps 94:19 ; Ps 138:3 ; Prov 29:17 . \ \ e. love: ׳ אהבה נ my soul loveth Song 1:7 ; Song 3:1 ; Song 3:2 ; Song 3:3 ; Song 3:4 ׳ יְדִדוּת נ darling of my soul Jer 12:7 ׳ ב ׳ דבקה נ his soul clave unto Gen 34:3 ( J ), with אחרי Ps 63:9 חשׁקה ׳ ב ׳ נ soul is attached to Gen 34:8 ( P ). feminine alienation, hatred, revenge: מן ׳ תֵּקַע נ the soul is alienated from Jer 6:8 ; Ezek 23:17 ; Ezek 23:18 מן ׳ נקעה נ Ezek 23:18 ; Ezek 23:22 ; Ezek 23:28 ׳ שְׂנֻאי נ hated of soul 2Sam 5:8 ( Qr ); ׳ שׂנאה נ Ps 11:5 ; Isa 1:14 . \ \ g. other emotions and feelings: ׳ השׁיב נ bring back soul Lam 1:11 ; Lam 1:19 (i.e. revive, compare with שׁוּב 1Kgs 17:21 f.), hence figurative refresh, cheer , v 1Kgs 17:16 ; Ps 19:8 ; Prov 25:14 ; Ruth 4:15 ׳ שׁובב נ Ps 23:3 ׳ מַחְמַל נ your souls' compassion Ezek 24:21 ׳ קצרה נ soul was impatient Num 21:4 ( E ), Judg 10:16 ; Judg 16:16 ; Zech 11:8 כי ׳ אאריך נ that I should prolong my patience Job 6:11 הגר ׳ ידעתם אתנֿ ye know the feeling of the stranger Exod 23:9 ( R D ). 7. נפשׁ is used occasionally for mental acts + לבב (see 10 ); possibly also alone, owing to unconscious assimilation by late writers; but most, if not all, examples may be otherwise explained: נפשׁי ידעת מאד Ps 139:14 my soul knoweth well (or I know well ; compare 4a ); בלא לא טוב ׳ דעת נ Prov 19:2 that the soul be without knowledge is not good (but RVm desire without knowledge , compare 6 a ); ׳ דעה חכמה לנ Prov 24:14 know wisdom for thy soul (or according to thy desire , compare 6 a ); ׳ אל תדמי בנ Esth 4:13 think not in thy soul (or in thyself , compare 4 b ); כמו שׁער ׳ בג Prov 23:7 as he reckoneth in his soul (but RV in himself , compare 4 b ); ׳ מה תאמר נ 1Sam 20:4 (but AV RV following ᵐ5 ἐπιθυμεῖ = תְּאַוֶּה ; see 6 a ). 8. נפשׁ for acts of the will is dubious: אם ישׁ נפשׁכם ( את ) if it is your purpose Gen 23:8 ( P ) 2Kgs 9:15 (or if it is your desire , 6 a ); ׳ בחרה נ my soul chooseth Job 7:15 ׳ מאנה נ my soul, refuseth Job 6:7 ; Ps 77:3 חפצה ׳ נ their soul delighteth in Isa 66:3 רצתה ׳ נ my soul delighteth in Isa 42:1 (all perhaps emotional, 6 b, d, g ). 9. נפשׁ = character is still more dubious: בּוֺ ׳ לאֹיָָֽֿשְׁרָה נ Hab 2:4 his soul is not right in him (but ᵐ5 οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ [ εὐδοκεῖ = רצתה ], see 6. ); נַפְשִׁי לאֹ מְטֻמָּאָה Ezek 4:14 my soul hath not (or I have not , 4 a ) been polluted. 10. ׳ נ in D , when used with לבב , is assimilated to it, and shares with it the meanings of 7, 8, 9 ; and so in later writers influenced by D (unless we may think that ׳ ל is used of intellect, while ׳ נ is used of the feelings): thus, בכל לבב ובכל נפשׁ (see לבב ): with דרשׁ Deut 4:29 ; 2Chr 15:12 עשׂה Deut 26:16 אהב Deut 6:5 ; Deut 13:4 ; Deut 30:6 ידע Josh 23:14 עבד Deut 10:12 ; Deut 11:13 ; Josh 22:5 שׁמע בקלו Deut 30:2 שׁוב אל Deut 30:10 ; 1Kgs 8:48 = 2Chr 6:38 ; 2Kgs 23:25 שׁמר מצות 2Kgs 23:3 = 2Chr 34:31 הלך לפני 1Kgs 2:4 and Deut 11:18 ; 1Sam 2:35 ; 1Chr 22:19 ; 1Chr 28:9 ; Jer 32:41 ; Ps 13:8 ; Prov 2:10 ; Prov 24:12 . Note. — In three cases is generally found closer approach to supposed radical meaning breath: — \ \ a. שׁמן וקטרת ישׂמח לב ומתק רעהו מעצת נפשׁ Prov 27:9 . Ges (after Döderlein) renders a. ׳ מעצת נ more than odorous trees , so later edds., even Buhl ; but ᵑ9 De SS transpose) מֵעֲצַת רֵעֵהוּ ׳ וּמֶתֶק נ . ᵐ5 Hi Bi ומתקרעה = the soul is rent asunder by cares . In any case נפשׁ is || לב , compare 10. b. נַפְשׁוֺ גֶּחָלִים תְּלַהֵט Job 41:13 his breath kindleth coals (of the crocodile).The piece is one of the latest in the book; primitive meaning hardly in such a passage; context favours reference to passion or fury ; perhaps below 6 f , his passion or fury kindleth coals. \ \ c. בָּתֵּי הַנֶּפֶשׁ Isa 3:20 perfume boxes ; meaning evident from context; but not necessarily scent (breath)-boxes ; may be 6 a , boxes of desire , or 5 , boxes exciting the sense of smell; = smelling boxes or bottles. No sufficient evidence in Biblical Hebrew, therefore, for meaning breath, odour . — See, for complete study of נֶפֶשׁ (all passages), Br JBL 1897,17 ff .

נֶ֫פֶשׁ756 noun feminineGen 49:6 (so even Gen 2:19; Num 31:28; 1Kgs 19:2 see AlbrZAW xvi (1896), 42 SS) soul, living being, life, self, person, desire, appetite, emotion, and passion (Eccl 3:18; Eccl 4:1 (twice in verse); Eccl 4:2 (twice in verse); Eccl 13:12; Eccl 14:11); — ׳נ Gen 1:20 +; נָ֑פֶשׁ Gen 37:21 +; suffix נַפְשִׁי Gen 12:13 +; plural נְפָשׁוֺת Ezek 13:18 + 13 t.; נְפָשֹׁת Exod 12:4; Lev 27:2 construct נַפְשׁוֺת Gen 36:6 + 4 t.; נַפְשֹׁת Lev 21:11 נְפָשִׁים Ezek 13:20 (but read חָפְשִׁים, see Co Berthol Toy); suffix נַפְשׁוֺתָם 2Sam 23:17 +; נַפְשֹׁתָם Num 17:3 +: —

1. = that which breathes, the breathing substance or being = ψυχή, anima, the soul, the inner being of man:
\ \ a. distinguished from ׃בָּשָׂר מִנֶּפֶשׁ וְעַד בָּשָׂר Isa 10:18 הַנֶּפֶשׁ עִם הַבָּשָׂר Deut 12:23 from שְׁאֵר Prov 11:17 from בֶּטֶן body Ps 31:10.
\ \ b. both the inner נפשׁ and the outer בשׂר are conceived as resting on a common substratum: אַךְ בְּשָׂרוֺ עָלָיו יִכְאָ֑ב וְנַפְשׁוֺ עָלָיו תֶּאֱבָֽל׃ Job 14:22 only his flesh upon him is in pain, and his soul upon him mourneth; compare Ps 42:5; Ps 42:7; Ps 131:2; Job 30:16; Lam 3:20 [see עַל 1 d], all poetical (compare 6 c).
\ \ c. ׳נ departs at death and returns with life: וַיְתִי בְּצֵאת נַפְשָׁהּ כִּי מֵתָה Gen 35:18 (E) and it came to pass when her soul was going forth (for she died); נָָֽפְחָה נַפְשָׁהּ Jer 15:9 she breathed out her soul, compare 1Kgs 17:21; 1Kgs 17:22; Job 11:20; Job 31:39.
\ \ d. often desired that the נפשׁ may be delivered: from Sh®°ôl Ps 16:10; Ps 30:4; Ps 49:16; Ps 86:13; Ps 89:49; Prov 23:14 from שַׁחַת, the pit of Sh®°ôl, Isa 38:17; Job 33:18; Job 33:22; Job 33:28; Job 33:30.
2. The נפשׁ becomes a living being: by God's breathing נשׁמת חיים into the nostrils of its בשׂר; of man Gen 2:7 (J); by implication of animals also Gen 2:19 (J); so Ps 104:29; Ps 104:30 compare Ps 66:9 man is נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה, a living, breathing being Gen 2:7 (J); elsewhere נפשׁ חיּה always of animals Gen 1:20; Gen 1:24; Gen 1:30; Gen 9:12; Gen 9:15; Gen 9:16 (all P), Ezek 47:9 so נפשׁ החיּה Gen 1:21; Gen 9:10 (both P), Lev 11:10; Lev 11:46 (H); נפשׁ השׁרצת Lev 11:46 (H); נפשׁ כל חי Job 12:10. נפשׁ is frequently used with the verb ׃חיה וחיתה נפשׁ Gen 12:13; Gen 19:20 (both J), 1Kgs 20:32 (E), Ps 119:175; Jer 38:17; Jer 38:20 חֵי נַפְשְׁךָ 1Sam 1:26; 1Sam 17:55; 1Sam 20:3; 1Sam 25:26; 2Sam 11:11; 2Sam 14:9; 2Kgs 2:2; 2Kgs 2:4; 2Kgs 2:6; 2Kgs 4:30 (all J E); compare ׳יְחַיֶּה נ 1Kgs 20:31 (E), Ezek 18:27; Ps 22:30 also Gen 19:19; Isa 55:3; Prov 3:22.
3. The נפשׁ (without חיה noun or verb) is specified:
\ \ a. a living being whose life resides in the blood [so in Arabic WeSkizzen iii. 217 G. JacobArab. Dicht. iv. 9 f.] (hence sacrificial use of blood, and its prohib. in other uses; first in D), Deut 12:23; Deut 12:24 only be sure that thou eat not the blood, for the blood is the living being (הַדָּם הוּא הַנֶּפֶשׁ); and thou shalt not eat the living being with the flesh (הַנֶּפֶשׁ עִם הַבָּשָׂר); thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water; this is enlarged in H, Lev 17:10; Lev 17:11; Lev 17:12; Lev 17:14 and in P Gen 9:4; Gen 9:5, compare Jer 2:34.
\ \ b. a serious attack upon the life is an attack upon this inner living being 2Sam 1:9; Jer 4:10; Jonah 2:6; Ps 69:2; Ps 124:4; Ps 124:5; Job 27:3.
\ \ c. נפשׁ is used for life itself 171 t., of animals Prov 12:10, and of man Gen 44:30 (J); נפשׁ תחת נפשׁ life for life Exod 21:23 (E), Lev 24:18 (H), 1Kgs 20:39; 1Kgs 20:42; 2Kgs 10:24 נפשׁנו תחתיכם Josh 2:14 (J); נפשׁ בנפשׁ Deut 19:21 בנפשׁ for the life of 2Sam 14:7; Jonah 1:14 שׂם נפשׁ בכף put life in one's own hand Judg 12:3; 1Sam 19:5; 1Sam 28:21; Job 13:14 חרף נפשׁו למות Judg 5:18 risked his life to die; בנפשׁ at the risk of life Num 17:3 (P), 2Sam 23:17 = 1Chr 11:19 (twice in verse), 1Kgs 2:23; Prov 7:23; Lam 5:9 בקּשׁ נפשׁ Exod 4:19 (J), 1Sam 20:21; 1Sam 22:23 (twice in verse); 1Sam 23:15; 1Sam 25:29; 2Sam 4:8; 2Sam 16:11; 1Kgs 19:10; 1Kgs 19:14; Jer 4:30; Jer 11:21; Jer 19:7; Jer 19:9; Jer 21:7; Jer 22:25; Jer 34:20; Jer 34:21; Jer 38:16; Jer 44:30 (twice in verse); Jer 46:26; Jer 49:37; Ps 35:4; Ps 38:13; Ps 40:15; Ps 54:5; Ps 63:10; Ps 70:3; Ps 86:14; Prov 29:10 ׳שׁאל נ 1Kgs 3:11 = 2Chr 1:11; 1Kgs 19:4 = Jonah 4:8 הִכָּה נפשׁ smite mortally Gen 37:21 (J), Deut 19:6; Deut 19:11; Jer 40:14; Jer 40:15 ׳לקח נ 1Kgs 19:4; Jonah 4:3; Ps 31:14; Prov 1:19 הִצִּיל נֶפֶשׁ מִמָּוֶת deliver life from death Josh 2:13; Ps 33:19; Ps 56:14 מלּט נפשׁ1Sam 19:11; 2Sam 19:6 (4 t. in verse); 1Kgs 1:12 (twice in verse); Jer 48:6; Jer 51:6; Jer 51:45; Ezek 33:5; Amos 2:14; Amos 2:15; Ps 89:49; Ps 116:4 פדה ׳נ 2Sam 4:9; 1Kgs 1:29; Ps 34:23; Ps 49:16; Ps 55:19; Ps 71:23 ׳שׁמר נ Ps 25:20; Ps 97:10; Job 2:6; Prov 13:3; Prov 16:17; Prov 19:16; Prov 22:5.
4. The נפשׁ as the essential of man stands for the man himself:
\ \ a. paraphrase for personal pronoun especially in poetry and ornate discourse, 70 t.; (1) נַפְשִׁי = me: אל תבא נפשׁי Gen 49:6 let me not enter (poem in J); מות ישׁרים ׳תָּמֹת נ Num 23:10 let me die, etc. (poem); תָּמוֺת נַפְשְׁי Judg 16:30 (J); אמרה נפשׁי Lam 3:24 I say. (2) נַפְשְׁךָ = thee: לְאֻמִּים תַּחַת נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ Isa 43:4 peoples instead of thee; אָֽמְרוּ לְנַפְשֵׁךְ Isa 51:23. (3) נַפְשׁוֺ = he: נפשׁו בטוב תלין Psalms he will not dwell in good circumstances. (4) נַפְשֵׁנוּ = we: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֺר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֺקְשִׁים Ps 124:7. (5) נַפְשָׁם = they, them: נַפְשָׁם בַּשְּׁבִי הָלָ֑כָה Isa 46:2 they are gone into captivity; אוי לנפשׁם Isa 3:9.
\ \ b. = reflexive, self, 53 t.: אסר על נפשׁ bind oneself Num 30:3; Num 30:5 (twice in verse); Num 30:6; Num 30:7; Num 30:8; Num 30:9; Num 30:10; Num 30:11; Num 30:12 ׳לְעַנֹּת נ Num 30:14 to afflict oneself . (1) נַפְשִׁי = myself: לא אדע נפשׁי Job 9:21 I know not myself. (2) נַפְשְׁךָ = thyself: ׳שׁמר נ Deut 4:9 keep thyself. (3) נַפְשׁוֺ = himself: ׳אהב כנ 1Sam 18:1; 1Sam 18:3; 1Sam 20:17 loved as himself. (4) נַפְשָׁהּ = herself: ׳צדּקה נ Jer 3:11 justified herself. (5) נַפְשָׁם = themselves: ׳הציל נ deliver themselves Isa 47:14; Ezek 14:14; Ezek 14:20. (6) נַפְשְׁכֶם, נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם = yourselves: ׳אַלתַּֿשִּׁאוּ נ Jer 37:9 deceive not yourselves, also Jer 42:20; Jer 44:7 ׳ענּה נ Lev 16:29; Lev 16:31; Lev 23:27; Lev 23:32; Num 29:7 (P); ׳נשׁמרתם לנ Deut 4:15; Josh 23:11 (D). (7) נַפְשׁוֺתֵינוּ = ourselves: ׳על נ Jer 26:19 against ourselves.
\ \ c. = person of man, individual, 144 t., first in D2; especially in H, P, and kindred writers: (1) with אָדָם: אדם ׳נ Lev 24:17 opposed to בהמה ׳נ Lev 24:18 (both H), and so אדם ׳נ human persons Num 31:35; Num 31:40; Num 31:46 (P) 1Chr 5:21; Ezek 27:13. Elsewhere without אדם: ברכה ׳נ Prov 11:25 one who blesses; רְמִיָּה ׳נ Prov 19:15 idle person; ׳תחת נ ׳נ person in place of person, Job 16:4 כפּר ׳על נ Exod 30:15; Exod 30:16; Num 15:28; Num 31:50 (all P) Lev 17:11 (H). (2) נפשׁ = person, any one: Deut 24:7; Deut 27:25; Prov 28:17; Ezek 18:4 (3 t. in verse); Ezek 33:6 elsewhere only H P: Lev 2:1; Lev 4:2; Lev 4:27; Lev 5:1; Lev 5:2; Lev 5:4; Lev 5:15; Lev 5:17; Lev 5:21; Lev 7:18; Lev 7:20; Lev 7:21; Lev 7:25; Lev 7:27; Lev 23:29; Lev 23:30 (twice in verse); Num 5:6; Num 15:27; Num 15:30; Num 19:22; Num 31:19; Num 31:28; Num 35:11; Num 35:15; Num 35:30 (twice in verse); Josh 20:3; Josh 20:9 (all P), Lev 17:10; Lev 17:12; Lev 17:15; Lev 20:6 (twice in verse); Lev 22:6; Lev 22:11 (all H); ׳נכרתה הנ הַהִוא מן that person shall be cut off from: only in Gen 17:14; Exod 12:15; Exod 12:19; Exod 31:14; Lev 7:20; Lev 7:21; Lev 7:27; Num 9:13; Num 15:30; Num 15:31; Num 19:13; Num 19:20 (all P), Lev 19:8; Lev 22:3 (both H). (3) נפשׁ collective for persons, in enumerations: Deut 10:22; Josh 10:28; Josh 10:30; Josh 10:32; Josh 10:35; Josh 10:37 (twice in verse); Josh 10:39; Josh 11:11 (all D2) Jer 43:6; Jer 52:29; Jer 52:30 (twice in verse); Ezek 22:25 elsewhere only Gen 12:5; Gen 46:15; Gen 46:18; Gen 46:22; Gen 46:25; Gen 46:26 (twice in verse); Gen 46:27 (twice in verse); Exod 1:5 (twice in verse); Exod 12:16; Num 31:35; Num 31:40 (all P). (4) נְפָשׁוֺת persons Gen 36:6; Exod 12:4; Exod 16:16; Num 19:18 (all P), Lev 18:29; Lev 20:25; Lev 27:2 (all H), 2Kgs 12:5; Prov 11:30; Prov 14:25; Ezek 13:18 (3 t. in verse); Ezek 13:19 (twice in verse); Ezek 13:20 (twice in verse); Ezek 17:17; Ezek 18:4; Ezek 22:27 (נפשׁים Ezek 13:20 see above). (5) נפשׁ = deceased person, sometimes with מֵת, נֶפֶשׁ מֵת Num 6:6 (P), נַפְשֹׁת מֵת (ᵐ5 ᵑ6 נֶפֶשׁ) Lev 21:11 (H); usually without מֵת, נפשׁ (ה)אדם Num 9:6; Num 9:7; Num 19:11; Num 19:13 (P); or simply נפשׁ, Lev 19:28; Lev 21:1; Lev 22:4 (all H) Num 5:2; Num 6:11; Num 9:10 (all P); elsewhere only Hag 2:13.
5. נפשׁ = seat of the appetites, in all periods (46 t.) —
\ \ a. hunger: רְעֵבָה ׳נ hungry soul Ps 107:9; Prov 27:7 with noun or verb of שׂבע satisfy Isa 56:11; Isa 58:10; Jer 50:19; Ezek 7:19; Ps 63:6; Ps 107:9; Prov 13:25; Prov 27:7 ׳מתוק לנ Prov 16:24 sweet to the taste.
\ \ b. thirst: עֲיֵפָה ׳נ weary soul Prov 25:25; Jer 31:25 כארץ עיפה ׳נ Ps 143:6 ׳צמאה נ Ps 42:3; Ps 63:2.
\ \ c. appetite in general: יַקִּיפוּ עָלָיו ׳אֹיְבַי בנ Ps 17:9 my enemies compass me about with greed; הִרְחִיבָה שְׁאוֺל נַפְשָׁהּ וּפָֽעֲרָה פִיהָ Isa 5:14 Sh®°ôl enlarged her appetite, etc., compare Hab 2:5; Prov 23:2 בַּעַל נֶפֶשׁ; Ecclesiastes uses נפשׁ only in the sense of a, b, c; the נפשׁ craves, lacks, and is filled with good things: Eccl 2:24; Eccl 4:8; Eccl 6:2; Eccl 6:3; Eccl 6:7; Eccl 6:9; Eccl 7:28.
6. = ׳נ seat of emotions and passions (151 t.) —
\ \ a. desire: ׳אִוְּתָה נ soul desires Deut 12:20; Deut 14:26; 1Sam 2:16; 2Sam 3:21; 1Kgs 11:37; Job 23:13; Prov 13:4; Prov 21:10; Mic 7:1 ׳תַּאֲוַת נ Ps 10:3; Isa 26:8 ׳אַוַּת נ Deut 12:15; Deut 12:20; Deut 12:21; Deut 18:6; 1Sam 23:20; Jer 2:24 so also לנפשׁ according to one's desire Deut 21:14; Ps 78:18; Jer 34:16 כנפשׁ Deut 23:25 האח נפשׁנו ah, our desire Ps 35:25 בנפשׁ at one's desire Ps 105:22; Ezek 16:27 יָָֽצְאָה ׳נ בְדַבְּרוֺ Song 5:6 ׳נשׂא נ lift up the soul, desire Deut 24:15; 2Sam 14:14 (read אליהם, not אלהים), Ps 24:4; Ps 25:1; Ps 86:4; Ps 143:8; Prov 19:8; Jer 22:27; Jer 44:14; Hos 4:8.
\ \ b. abhorrence, loathing: ׳געלה נ soul abhorreth Lev 26:11; Lev 26:15; Lev 26:30; Lev 26:43 (H) Jer 14:19 בחלה בי ׳וגם נ Zech 11:8 and their soul also fell a loathing against me.
\ \ c. sorrow and distress: ׳מרי נ bitter, gloomy, discontented of soul Judg 18:25 (E) 2Sam 17:8; Job 3:20; Prov 31:6 ׳מר נ 1Sam 22:2 compare Job 7:11; Job 10:1; Isa 38:15; Ezek 27:1 ׳עָֽגְמָה נ Job 30:35 grieved; ׳אגמי נ sad of soul Isa 19:10 ׳תבכה נ my soul shall weep Jer 13:17 ירעה ׳נ his soul trembleth Isa 15:4 ׳צרת נ distress of soul Gen 42:21 (E).
\ \ d. joy: תגיל ׳נ my soul rejoiceth Ps 35:9; Isa 61:10 ׳שׂמּח נ rejoice the soul Ps 86:4 also Ps 94:19; Ps 138:3; Prov 29:17.
\ \ e. love: ׳אהבה נ my soul loveth Song 1:7; Song 3:1; Song 3:2; Song 3:3; Song 3:4 ׳יְדִדוּת נ darling of my soul Jer 12:7 ׳ב ׳דבקה נ his soul clave unto Gen 34:3 (J), with אחרי Ps 63:9 חשׁקה ׳ב ׳נ soul is attached to Gen 34:8 (P). feminine alienation, hatred, revenge: מן ׳תֵּקַע נ the soul is alienated from Jer 6:8; Ezek 23:17; Ezek 23:18 מן ׳נקעה נ Ezek 23:18; Ezek 23:22; Ezek 23:28 ׳שְׂנֻאי נ hated of soul 2Sam 5:8 (Qr); ׳שׂנאה נ Ps 11:5; Isa 1:14.
\ \ g. other emotions and feelings: ׳השׁיב נ bring back soul Lam 1:11; Lam 1:19 (i.e. revive, compare with שׁוּב 1Kgs 17:21f.), hence figurative refresh, cheer, v1Kgs 17:16; Ps 19:8; Prov 25:14; Ruth 4:15 ׳שׁובב נ Ps 23:3 ׳מַחְמַל נ your souls' compassion Ezek 24:21 ׳קצרה נ soul was impatient Num 21:4 (E), Judg 10:16; Judg 16:16; Zech 11:8 כי ׳אאריך נ that I should prolong my patience Job 6:11 הגר ׳ידעתם אתנֿ ye know the feeling of the stranger Exod 23:9 (RD).

7. נפשׁ is used occasionally for mental acts + לבב (see 10); possibly also alone, owing to unconscious assimilation by late writers; but most, if not all, examples may be otherwise explained: נפשׁי ידעת מאד Ps 139:14 my soul knoweth well (or I know well; compare 4a); בלא לא טוב ׳דעת נ Prov 19:2 that the soul be without knowledge is not good (but RVm desire without knowledge, compare 6 a); ׳דעה חכמה לנ Prov 24:14 know wisdom for thy soul (or according to thy desire, compare 6 a); ׳אל תדמי בנ Esth 4:13 think not in thy soul (or in thyself, compare 4 b); כמו שׁער ׳בג Prov 23:7 as he reckoneth in his soul (but RV in himself, compare 4 b); ׳מה תאמר נ 1Sam 20:4 (but AV RV following ᵐ5 ἐπιθυμεῖ = תְּאַוֶּה; see 6 a).

8. נפשׁ for acts of the will is dubious: אם ישׁ נפשׁכם (את) if it is your purpose Gen 23:8 (P) 2Kgs 9:15 (or if it is your desire, 6 a); ׳בחרה נ my soul chooseth Job 7:15 ׳מאנה נ my soul, refuseth Job 6:7; Ps 77:3 חפצה ׳נ their soul delighteth in Isa 66:3 רצתה ׳נ my soul delighteth in Isa 42:1 (all perhaps emotional, 6 b, d, g).

9. נפשׁ = character is still more dubious: בּוֺ ׳לאֹיָָֽֿשְׁרָה נ Hab 2:4 his soul is not right in him (but ᵐ5 οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ [εὐδοκεῖ = רצתה], see
6.); נַפְשִׁי לאֹ מְטֻמָּאָה Ezek 4:14 my soul hath not (or I have not, 4 a) been polluted.
10. ׳נin D, when used with לבב, is assimilated to it, and shares with it the meanings of 7, 8, 9; and so in later writers influenced by D (unless we may think that ׳ל is used of intellect, while ׳נ is used of the feelings): thus, בכל לבב ובכל נפשׁ (see לבב): with דרשׁ Deut 4:29; 2Chr 15:12 עשׂה Deut 26:16 אהב Deut 6:5; Deut 13:4; Deut 30:6 ידע Josh 23:14 עבד Deut 10:12; Deut 11:13; Josh 22:5 שׁמע בקלו Deut 30:2 שׁוב אל Deut 30:10; 1Kgs 8:48 = 2Chr 6:38; 2Kgs 23:25 שׁמר מצות 2Kgs 23:3 = 2Chr 34:31 הלך לפני1Kgs 2:4 and Deut 11:18; 1Sam 2:35; 1Chr 22:19; 1Chr 28:9; Jer 32:41; Ps 13:8; Prov 2:10; Prov 24:12. Note. — In three cases is generally found closer approach to supposed radical meaning breath: —
\ \ a. שׁמן וקטרת ישׂמח לב ומתק רעהו מעצת נפשׁ Prov 27:9. Ges (after Döderlein) renders a. ׳מעצת נ more than odorous trees, so later edds., even Buhl; but ᵑ9 De SS transpose) מֵעֲצַת רֵעֵהוּ ׳וּמֶתֶק נ. ᵐ5 Hi Bi ומתקרעה = the soul is rent asunder by cares. In any case נפשׁis || לב, compare
10. b. נַפְשׁוֺ גֶּחָלִים תְּלַהֵט Job 41:13 his breath kindleth coals (of the crocodile).The piece is one of the latest in the book; primitive meaning hardly in such a passage; context favours reference to passion or fury; perhaps below 6 f, his passion or fury kindleth coals.
\ \ c. בָּתֵּי הַנֶּפֶשׁ Isa 3:20 perfume boxes; meaning evident from context; but not necessarily scent (breath)-boxes; may be 6 a, boxes of desire, or 5, boxes exciting the sense of smell; = smelling boxes or bottles. No sufficient evidence in Biblical Hebrew, therefore, for meaning breath, odour. — See, for complete study of נֶפֶשׁ (all passages), BrJBL 1897,17 ff.
